cases.name: mutual joins without effects end as deadlock
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
definition "function right(xs: Any) -> Any
kernel 1
metering statements
body {
  do yield
  let h = xs[0]
  do join(h)
}
"
definition "function left(xs: Any) -> Any
kernel 1
metering statements
body {
  do yield
  let h = xs[1]
  do join(h)
}
"
main {
  let xs = [null, null]
  let a = spawn invoke left(xs)
  let b = spawn invoke right(xs)
  set xs[0] = a
  set xs[1] = b
  let tasks = [a, b]
  do join all(tasks)
}
